instruction:
Begin with /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-12_input.step. To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH). Before starting the work, use `/usr/lib/freecad/bin/freecadcmd-python3` for the FreeCAD command-line work in this task when working on `freecad_task-12_input.step`.

The input L bracket has a base spanning X=0..140, Y=0..66, Z=0..12 and a vertical wall spanning X=0..140, Y=58..66, Z=12..90. Add and fuse three triangular reinforcing ribs, each 6 mm thick in X and centered at X=30, 70, and 110. Each rib has a triangular Y-Z profile with base leg from Y=30 to Y=58 on Z=12 and vertical leg from Z=12 to Z=55 at Y=30. Cut two vertical through holes of diameter 10 mm in the base at (35,28) and (105,28). Cut two through holes through the vertical wall along Y: diameter 12 mm centered at X=50, Z=52, and diameter 10 mm centered at X=92, Z=68. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-12_output.step.
